Macquarie Downgrades Canadian Railway (CNI); American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings (AXL) Has 2.92 Sentiment
May 17, 2018 - By Migdalia James
New York-listed Canadian Railway (NYSE:CNI) , was decreased by stock research analysts at Macquarie. Macquarie decreased its rating on the $61.60B market cap company to a Hold.
American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings Inc (AXL) investors sentiment increased to 2.92 in Q4 2017 . It’s up 1.97, from 0.95 in 2017Q3. The ratio is positive, as 152 funds started new and increased holdings, while 52 reduced and sold positions in American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings Inc. The funds in our database now possess: 113.60 million shares, down from 115.24 million shares in 2017Q3. The lowest target is $12.0 while the high is $24.0. The stock’s average target of $19.75 is 22.29% above today’s ($16.15) share price. AXL was included in 8 notes of analysts from November 4, 2016. American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, engineers, validates, and makes driveline and drivetrain systems, and related components and chassis modules for the automotive industry in the United States, Canada, Mexico, South America, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company has market cap of $1.80 billion. It offers axles, driveheads, chassis modules, driveshafts, power transfer units, transfer cases, chassis and steering components, transmission parts, electric drive systems, and metal-formed products that transfer power from the transmission to the drive wheels. It has a 5.03 P/E ratio. The firm offers its products for light trucks, sport utility vehicles, passenger cars, and crossover and commercial vehicles.
Analysts await American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:AXL) to report earnings on July, 27. They expect $1.12 EPS, up 13.13% or $0.13 from last year’s $0.99 per share. AXL’s profit will be $125.04M for 3.60 P/E if the $1.12 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.98 actual EPS reported by American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 14.29% EPS growth.

Canadian National Railway Company engages in rail and related transportation business. The company has market cap of $61.60 billion. The firm transports cargo, serving exporters, importers, retailers, farmers, and manufacturers. It has a 15.19 P/E ratio. It operates a network of approximately 20,000 route miles of track spans Canada and mid-America connecting the Atlantic, the Pacific, and the Gulf of Mexico.
